question: How has Ted Cruz voted?
text: Ted Cruz voted Yea on 8 and Nay on 5 of the 13 key votes held in the Senate; the other 7 have only a House roll call.

votes.keyVote: Permanently put fentanyl-related drugs in the strictest drug category (S. 331)
2025 tax and spending law (H.R. 1, known as the One Big Beautiful Bill Act)
Extend the larger ACA health plan tax credits for 3 years (H.R. 1834)
Detain certain immigrants arrested for or charged with some crimes (Laken Riley Act)
End the national emergency behind tariffs on Canada (H.J.Res. 72 and S.J.Res. 37)
Require proof of citizenship to register to vote in federal elections (H.R. 22)
votes.memberVote: House vote only: senators do not vote on House roll calls

votes.keyVote: Direct the President to end U.S. hostilities with Iran (H.Con.Res. 86)
Cancel California's waiver for its zero-emission car sales rules (H.J.Res. 88)
Cancel the March 2025 order ending union bargaining at many federal agencies (H.R. 2550)
votes.memberVote: House vote only: senators do not vote on House roll calls

votes.keyVote: Require care for infants born alive after an attempted abortion (H.R. 21 and S. 6)
Authorize military aid to Ukraine and conditional sanctions on Russia (H.R. 2913)
votes.memberVote: House vote only: senators do not vote on House roll calls

votes.keyVote: Limit girls' and women's school sports teams to students born female (H.R. 28 and S. 9)
Require temporary protected status for Haiti until 2029 (H.R. 1689)
votes.memberVote: House vote only: senators do not vote on House roll calls

votes.keyVote: Set federal rules for payment stablecoins, a type of digital token (S. 1582)
End the national energy emergency declared in January 2025 (S.J.Res. 10)
Cancel about $9 billion already approved for public broadcasting and foreign aid (H.R. 4)
End the national emergency behind the April 2025 global tariffs (S.J.Res. 88)
Bar card networks from using a sales code just for gun sellers (H.R. 1181)
votes.memberVote: House vote only: senators do not vote on House roll calls

votes.memberVote: House vote only: senators do not vote on House roll calls

votes.keyVote: Tie college student aid to not joining commercial boycotts of Israel (H.R. 4795)
